text:
maria: Quick heads-up — request to sticky-pin SDK 2.8.0 in eu-west for 72h. We've seen an evaluator score regression with llama4q + runtime 3.2 on longseq tests. Pin would prevent automatic unpin/backfill while we triage. TL;DR: hold unpin, avoid mass fallback. @deploybot please hold unpin actions for eu-west.

alex: Can you paste the failure pattern? Is it perf or correctness?

maria: Mostly quality delta on our reranker/evaluator harness — increased hallucination rate at >4k tokens. Telemetry snippet:

``
metric: evaluator.loss_longseq
before: 0.82
after: 1.12
sample_count: 1200
```

maria: Also a handful of customer reports hitting long-conversation flows.

nate: :eyes: Is this specific to SDK 2.8.0 or runtime 3.2 interplay?

maria: Appears to be the combination. SDK 2.8.0 changes in dynamic-kvcache serialization + runtime 3.2's new attention kernel. Alone they pass. Together we see regression.

lee: How widespread is traffic in eu-west? Any impact if we pin only eu-west vs global?

sophie: eu-west is ~18% of production traffic for these models. Pinning regionally should limit blast radius.

deploybot: [system] Received hold-unpin request: scope=eu-west, reason="evaluator regression", duration=72h, owner=maria. Action: HOLD_APPLIED

alex: Suggestion: create canary with SDK 2.8.1 that reverts serialization change and run evaluator harness. If passes, we can unstick and roll.

maria: Agree. Can we schedule a canary build? @eng-runtime can we run a small canary (5% traffic) with SDK 2.8.1 + runtime 3.2 tomorrow 02:00 UTC?

sam: I can slot it. Will also attach an e2e prompt set. We'll monitor eval_score and latency.

lee: Also add a fallback policy: if evaluator.loss_longseq > 1.0 for 30m, auto-reroute to runtime 3.1 in eu-west.

devops-bot: [alert] Route fallback rule created: threshold=1.0, window=30m, fallback=runtime-3.1

maria: Thanks. Plan: apply regional sticky-pin now, run canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC, 24h observation, then decide. If canary looks good -> remove pin and roll. If not -> extend pin + engage runtime/SDK owners.

nate: Acknowledged. Can we add a note to release notes: 'temporary regional SDK pin applied due to evaluator regression; may affect canary rollout'?

maria: Yes, I'll draft a short blurb for release notes and customer status page.

sophie: :thumbsup:

alex: FYI, I'll prepare a small rollback playbook in case canary worsens production. Keep us looped.

maria: Deploybot shows HOLD_APPLIED. I'll follow up with a quick PR for release-notes and link to the triage doc.

sophie: Thanks all — let's reconvene in #eng-releases after the 02:00 canary kickoff.
